author: ai
text: In 2024, net imports were 67% of China's oil use, 39% of its gas use (U.S. Energy Information Administration, 2024) and 84% of its soybean use (FAOSTAT, 2024). Russia was the main supplier of its major arms imports, at 67% (SIPRI, 2021–2025). China produced an estimated 99% of world gallium and 69% of world rare earths (USGS, 2025). It has 1.41 billion people and a GDP of US$19.5 trillion, ranked second of 186 places on GDP (World Bank, 2025).
